name: spawning_salmon
notes: Salmon on the spawning run up the delta's clear channel: crimson flanks and olive-green heads, holding in knee-deep water over the cobbles.

morphs.name: bright
morphs.notes: Fresh run from the sea: steel-blue back, bright silver sides.

morphs.name: run
morphs.notes: Spawning colour, deep in the run: dark olive-bronze back, coppery red flanks.
